international.title: Burnham should ‘move on’ from Brexit, says Theresa May, as critics hit out over closer EU ties – UK politics live
international.summary: Issue dominates Sunday broadcast round following Friday’s deals on trade and youth mobility Theresa May ‘aghast’ at Andy Burnham’s talk about rejoining EU Critics of the youth mobility deal have mainly focused on the idea of an “influx” of European youth competing with Brits for jobs when there’s this ongoing Neets crisis. Roughly one million 16-24 year-olds in the UK aren’t in education, employment or training (Neet). There’ll be young people from Britain going to work in Europe, and study, and live, and there’ll be young people from Europe coming to our country as well. I absolutely believe we can both address the issue of Neets, which I think Alan Melbourne did excellently this week, and we can address the issue of young people having the freedom to go and work and live in Europe. What we’re saying is that actually, yes, we should integrate into the market where for the first time, we’ll be able to shape decisions agreed to in the EU. Continue reading...
